Ole Thorlacius-Ussing is a medical doctor (dr.med.) and chief physician (overlæge) who represents Region Nordjylland (North Denmark Region) in national healthcare coordination efforts [^src1]. Specifically, he serves as a member of the steering group for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD), the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease [^src1].

In his capacity on the steering group, Thorlacius-Ussing acts as part of the strategic management unit for a broad national initiative to systematize and improve IBD treatment across Denmark [^src1]. This role connects Region Nordjylland's clinical practices to nationally coordinated quality goals. The database and its steering group oversee cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and the evaluation of treatment access, focusing on specific clinical benchmarks and quality indicators such as patient education and the application of biologics and small molecules [^src1].
